title: 解約不被牽著走
subtitle: 12 句英文，健身房、手機合約都適用

lines.say: Hi, I'd like to cancel my membership.
lines.zh: 嗨，我想取消會員。

lines.say: No problem! Have you thought about our Platinum plan instead? It's only ten euro more.
lines.zh: 沒問題！你有考慮過我們的白金方案嗎？只要多十歐。

lines.say: Em… OK?
lines.zh: 呃……好？

lines.say: True story. I went in to cancel my gym, and I walked out with a more expensive one.
lines.zh: 真實故事。我走進去要取消健身房，走出來卻升級成更貴的方案。

lines.say: I paid for a gym I never visited for eight more months.
lines.zh: 之後八個月，我一直在付一間我根本沒去的健身房。

board.cta: 解約不被牽著走・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for cancelling a contract. A gym, a phone plan, anything.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教十二句解約用的話，健身房、手機合約都適用。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for cancelling a contract. A gym, a phone plan, anything.

lines.say: You'll learn to stay polite, repeat yourself, and not leave until it's done.
lines.zh: 你會學到怎麼保持禮貌、重複立場，而且不辦完不離開。

lines.say: Part one: say it clearly.
lines.zh: 第一段：把來意說清楚。

lines.say: Their job is to keep you. Your job is to be clear from the first sentence.
lines.zh: 他們的工作是留住你。你的工作是第一句話就講清楚。

lines.say: If you say: I'm thinking about maybe cancelling, you've just invited a sales talk.
lines.zh: 如果你說「我在考慮也許要取消」，等於邀請對方開始推銷。

lines.say: Be polite, but leave no door open.
lines.zh: 要有禮貌，但不要留任何空間。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: I'd like to cancel my membership, please.
scenes.note: I'd like to ＝ 有禮貌但很明確

lines.say: I'd like to cancel my membership, please.
I'd like to is polite, but it's a decision, not a question.
lines.zh: I'd like to 很有禮貌，但它是決定，不是詢問。

lines.say: A membership is your right to use the gym. For a phone, say contract.
lines.zh: membership 是會員資格。如果是手機，就說 contract。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'd like to cancel my membership, please.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: I signed up in March on a twelve-month contract.
scenes.meaning: 我是三月簽約的，簽了十二個月

lines.say: Next, give them the facts they need.
lines.zh: 接著給對方需要的資訊。

lines.say: I signed up in March on a twelve-month contract.
Sign up means join or register.
lines.zh: sign up 是加入、註冊。

lines.say: Notice: a twelve-month contract. No s on month, because it describes the contract.
lines.zh: 注意是 twelve-month contract，month 沒有 s，因為它在形容合約。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I signed up in March on a twelve-month contract.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I'm moving away, so I won't be able to use it.
scenes.meaning: 我要搬走了，所以沒辦法繼續使用
scenes.note: won't be able to ＝ 將無法

lines.say: They'll ask why. Give one short reason, and stop.
lines.zh: 對方會問原因。給一個簡短的理由，然後停。

lines.say: I'm moving away, so I won't be able to use it.
Won't be able to is the future of can't.
lines.zh: won't be able to 是 can't 的未來式。

lines.say: One reason is enough. The more you explain, the more they can argue with.
lines.zh: 一個理由就夠了。你解釋越多，對方能反駁的就越多。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm moving away, so I won't be able to use it.

scenes.title: Hold your ground
scenes.sub: 被挽留：重複立場，不要動搖

lines.say: Part two: hold your ground.
lines.zh: 第二段：守住立場。

lines.say: Now come the offers. A discount, a free month, a freeze. This is where I lost.
lines.zh: 接下來就是各種優惠：折扣、免費一個月、暫停會籍。我就是在這裡輸的。

lines.say: The technique is called the broken record. You repeat the same message, calmly, as many times as you need.
lines.zh: 這個技巧叫「跳針唱片」：冷靜地重複同一句話，要幾次就幾次。

lines.say: You don't need a new reason every time.
lines.zh: 你不需要每次都想新的理由。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: I understand that, but I'd still like to cancel.
scenes.meaning: 我了解，但我還是想取消
scenes.note: I understand that, but… ＝ 先接住再堅持

lines.say: I understand that, but I'd still like to cancel.
First you show you listened: I understand that. Then but, and the same message.
lines.zh: 先表示你有在聽：I understand that。然後 but，再接同一句話。

lines.say: The little word still does the work. It means nothing has changed.
lines.zh: still 這個小字最關鍵，表示什麼都沒有改變。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I understand that, but I'd still like to cancel.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: I'm not interested in freezing it, thanks.
scenes.meaning: 我沒有要暫停會籍，謝謝

lines.say: They'll offer to freeze it. That means pause it and keep you as a customer.
lines.zh: 對方會提議 freeze，也就是暫停，同時把你留著。

lines.say: I'm not interested in freezing it, thanks.
After interested in, use the i-n-g form: freezing.
lines.zh: interested in 後面接 ing：freezing。

lines.say: And thanks at the end keeps it friendly. Firm and friendly can go together.
lines.zh: 最後加 thanks 保持友善。堅定和友善可以同時存在。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'm not interested in freezing it, thanks.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: Could you talk me through the cancellation process?
scenes.meaning: 可以一步一步告訴我解約流程嗎？
scenes.note: talk me through ＝ 一步步說明給我聽

lines.say: Now move the conversation forward yourself.
lines.zh: 現在由你把對話往前推。

lines.say: Could you talk me through the cancellation process?
Talk me through means explain it to me step by step.
lines.zh: talk me through 是一步一步解釋給我聽。

lines.say: You've stopped asking if you can cancel. Now you're asking how.
lines.zh: 你不再問「能不能」取消，而是問「怎麼」取消。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you talk me through the cancellation process?
Watch the broken record in action.
lines.zh: 來看跳針唱片怎麼用。

lines.say: What if I give you two months free?
lines.zh: 如果我送你兩個月免費呢？

lines.say: I understand that, but I'd still like to cancel.
lines.zh: 我了解，但我還是想取消。

lines.say: We could freeze it until you're back?
lines.zh: 我們可以先暫停，等你回來？

lines.say: I'm not interested in freezing it, thanks. Could you talk me through the cancellation process?
lines.zh: 我沒有要暫停，謝謝。可以一步一步告訴我解約流程嗎？

lines.say: OK. Sure. Let me pull up your account.
lines.zh: 好吧，我叫出你的帳戶資料。

lines.say: Two offers, two calm answers. Nobody got upset.
lines.zh: 兩個優惠、兩次冷靜的回答，沒有人不高興。

scenes.title: Know the terms
scenes.sub: 講條款：合約怎麼寫就怎麼辦

lines.say: Part three: know the terms.
lines.zh: 第三段：搞清楚條款。

lines.say: Sometimes they say you can't cancel yet, or there's a fee. Read your contract before you go in.
lines.zh: 有時候他們會說還不能解約，或是要收費。進去之前先把合約讀一遍。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: According to the contract, I only need to give thirty days' notice.
scenes.meaning: 根據合約，我只需要提前三十天通知

lines.say: According to the contract, I only need to give thirty days' notice.
According to means: this is what it says. It's not your opinion. It's on paper.
lines.zh: according to 是「上面是這樣寫的」。這不是你的意見，是白紙黑字。

lines.say: Notice here means telling them in advance that you're leaving.
lines.zh: 這裡的 notice 是提前告知你要離開。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: According to the contract, I only need to give thirty days' notice.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I wasn't told about a cancellation fee when I signed up.
scenes.meaning: 簽約的時候沒有人告訴我有解約金
scenes.note: I wasn't told ＝ 沒有人告訴我

lines.say: And if a surprise fee appears, say this.
lines.zh: 如果突然冒出一筆費用，就這樣說。

lines.say: I wasn't told about a cancellation fee when I signed up.
I wasn't told is passive. You're not blaming this person. You're just stating a fact.
lines.zh: I wasn't told 是被動語態。你沒有怪眼前這個人，只是在陳述事實。

lines.say: That keeps them on your side, and they're the one who can remove the fee.
lines.zh: 這樣對方還是站在你這邊，而能幫你取消費用的就是他。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I wasn't told about a cancellation fee when I signed up.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Is there someone else I could speak to about this?
scenes.meaning: 有其他人可以跟我談這件事嗎？
scenes.note: 比 I want to see the manager 更客氣

lines.say: If you're really stuck, go one level up. Politely.
lines.zh: 如果真的卡住了，就往上找。有禮貌地。

lines.say: Is there someone else I could speak to about this?
It means: I'd like to talk to your manager. But it doesn't sound like a threat.
lines.zh: 意思是我想找你的主管，但聽起來不像威脅。

lines.say: Often, just asking this question makes the problem disappear.
lines.zh: 很多時候光問這一句，問題就消失了。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Is there someone else I could speak to about this?

scenes.title: Get proof
scenes.sub: 留紀錄：沒有 email 就等於沒解約

lines.say: Part four: get proof.
lines.zh: 第四段：留下證據。

lines.say: They say: that's all cancelled for you. Lovely. But don't leave yet.
lines.zh: 對方說：都幫你取消好了。很好，但先別走。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Could you confirm that by email?
scenes.meaning: 可以用 email 跟我確認嗎？

lines.say: Could you confirm that by email?
To confirm by email means to send you a message that says it's done.
lines.zh: confirm by email 是寄一封信說明已經辦好。

lines.say: If money leaves your account later, that email is your proof.
lines.zh: 之後如果又被扣款，這封信就是你的證據。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you confirm that by email?

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: When will the last payment come out of my account?
scenes.meaning: 最後一筆款項什麼時候會從我帳戶扣？
scenes.note: come out of my account ＝ 從帳戶扣款

lines.say: Then check the money.
lines.zh: 接著確認錢的部分。

lines.say: When will the last payment come out of my account?
When money comes out of your account, the company takes the payment.
lines.zh: come out of my account 是公司從你的帳戶扣款。

lines.say: Put that date in your phone, and check your bank the day after.
lines.zh: 把日期記在手機裡，隔天檢查銀行帳戶。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: When will the last payment come out of my account?

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: I'd rather get this settled today, if possible.
scenes.meaning: 如果可以，我想今天就把這件事處理完
scenes.note: I'd rather ＝ 我比較想　settled ＝ 解決

lines.say: And if they say: come back tomorrow, or: ring this number.
lines.zh: 如果對方說「明天再來」或「打這支電話」。

lines.say: I'd rather get this settled today, if possible.
I'd rather means I would prefer. Settled means finished and decided.
lines.zh: I'd rather 是「我比較希望」，settled 是處理完畢。

lines.say: Come back tomorrow is how eight more months happened to me.
lines.zh: 「明天再來」就是我多付八個月的原因。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'd rather get this settled today, if possible.
There is a fifty euro cancellation fee.
lines.zh: 解約要收五十歐的手續費。

lines.say: I wasn't told about a cancellation fee when I signed up. According to the contract, I only need to give thirty days' notice.
lines.zh: 簽約的時候沒有人告訴我有解約金。根據合約，我只需要提前三十天通知。

lines.say: Let me check. You're right. No fee.
lines.zh: 我查一下。你說得對，不用手續費。

lines.say: Great. Could you confirm that by email?
lines.zh: 太好了。可以用 email 跟我確認嗎？

lines.say: Sending it now.
lines.zh: 現在就寄。

lines.say: Fifty euro saved, with two sentences.
lines.zh: 兩句話，省下五十歐。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：遇到不合理的事

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish expressions for when someone is being a bit cheeky.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！兩句愛爾蘭說法，用在對方有點得寸進尺的時候。

lines.say: That surprise fee? Your Irish friend would say the gym was doing this.
lines.zh: 那筆突然冒出來的費用？你的愛爾蘭朋友會說健身房在做這件事。

lines.say: They were chancing their arm.
It means they tried it, just in case you'd say yes.
lines.zh: 意思是他們試試看，萬一你就答應了呢。

lines.say: And when something is really too much, Irish people say just two words.
lines.zh: 如果事情真的太過分，愛爾蘭人只說兩個字。

lines.say: Ah, here!
It means: come on, that's not fair! Say it with a smile, to friends, not to the staff.
lines.zh: 意思是：拜託，這不合理吧！帶著笑說，對朋友說，不要對店員說。

lines.say: Ah, here!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：這次真的解約成功

lines.say: Let's go back to that gym and do it properly. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 我們回到那間健身房，這次好好辦。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: I'd like to cancel my membership, please.
lines.zh: 我想取消會員，麻煩你。

lines.say: Have you thought about our Platinum plan?
lines.zh: 你有考慮過我們的白金方案嗎？

lines.say: I understand that, but I'd still like to cancel.
lines.zh: 我了解，但我還是想取消。

lines.say: No problem. That's done for you.
lines.zh: 沒問題，幫你辦好了。

lines.say: Could you confirm that by email? And when will the last payment come out of my account?
lines.zh: 可以用 email 跟我確認嗎？還有，最後一筆款項什麼時候會扣？

lines.say: Email sent. The last payment is on the first of next month.
lines.zh: 信寄出了。最後一筆是下個月一號。

items: I'd like to cancel my membership, please.
I signed up in March on a twelve-month contract.
I'm moving away, so I won't be able to use it.
I understand that, but I'd still like to cancel.
I'm not interested in freezing it, thanks.
Could you talk me through the cancellation process?
According to the contract, I only need to give thirty days' notice.
I wasn't told about a cancellation fee when I signed up.
Is there someone else I could speak to about this?
Could you confirm that by email?
When will the last payment come out of my account?
I'd rather get this settled today, if possible.

lines.say: And you're free! Polite the whole time, and you got what you came for.
lines.zh: 自由了！全程有禮貌，而且達成目的。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Take a screenshot before you walk in.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，走進去之前先截圖。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: And sorry, you can't cancel me. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 還有，抱歉，我是沒辦法取消的。下一課見，Bye！
